decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line close to the core business, its value is still uncertain one year after launch and carrying it costs little on existing slicing and packaging lines, so the option is worth keeping.

The organic poultry snack has its own web page and fits the firm's organic expansion, so with little evidence of failure and low carrying cost, waiting is better than dropping, though niche snack SKUs are often delisted by retailers.
The premium sharing salami line is presented prominently and uses established salami capabilities, so its option value remains while market uptake is still uncertain.
